provenance.tool: dstack-mr 0.6.3 (dstack-TEE/dstack commit d7e15dc, branch next), Machine::measure() — the full-image TDX path dstack's own verifier uses (dstack/verifier/src/verification.rs::compute_measurements)
provenance.reproduction: research/dstack-mr-derivation-2026-11-05/ (harness source, vm_configs, per-image derivation and shape-sensitivity records)
provenance.independence: values computed from published OS image archives (hash chain and manifest member digests re-verified on download 2026-11-05) before any comparison with observed quotes; all retained NEAR quotes whose image is published matched afterwards, as did the 2026-11-05 Venice capture and the aci lane's derivation of the same image and VM shape
provenance.mrtd_two_variants: MRTD depends on the QEMU page-add order; qemu 8.x measures two-pass and qemu 9.x single-pass. Both derived variants are accepted per image because NEAR does not expose vm_config. teep's capture-derived MRTD pins {b24d3b24…, f06dfda6…, df4d77c8…} are exactly three of these build-derived variants.
provenance.rtmr0_policy: RTMR0 depends on the VM shape (cpu, memory, gpus, hugepages, hotplug, qemu, ovmf variant). Each vm_shapes entry pins one derived (mrtd, rtmr0) tuple; the shape is derivation input, not something matched against a served vm_config. Images without vm_shapes leave tee_hardware_config unproven (None).
provenance.review: values accepted by this repo's review workflow; a provider-published or newly observed value is not automatically added

vm_shapes.derived: dstack-mr on zed 2026-11-15, see research/dstack-mr-derivation-2026-11-05/README.md; full-length rtmr0 hex copied from the matching quote in evidence 2d27859e (the review recorded the derivation output by prefix)
